title: QueryNavigation
description: This message shall cause the receiving component to reply to the requestor with a ID 4421: ReportNavigation message. A logical AND shall be performed on the requested presence vectors and that representing the available fields from the responder. The resulting message shall contain the fields indicated by the result of this logical AND operation.

MessageID.comment: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

GlobalPosePresenceVector.comment: See Report Global Pose Ext State Message

LocalPosePresenceVector.comment: See Report Local Pose Ext State Message

VelocityStatePresenceVector.comment: See Report Velocity State Ext State Message
